text:
ara: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of stale aggregate replays kicking off when late windows shift. Thinking we need a 'horizon slice cooldown' to avoid repeating slices while upstream lag oscillates. Details below.

sam: Can you paste an example? Are these the 1h slices that overlap by 10m?

ara: Yeah, observed in prod last night: two concurrent replays for same slice when late events arrived ~8m after window. Resulted in duplicate compute and throttle spikes.

mira: yikes. Do we dedupe by slice id currently? I thought we had idempotency at the partition level.

ara: We dedupe by sequence id but the replayer treats late windows as new jobs if watermark moves backwards. So we end up with N jobs for the same slice.

jon: propose cooldown gate: once a slice replayer runs, mark slice as cooling for X mins and reject or queue subsequent requests. That avoids repeated heavy runs.

kevin: what's the tradeoff for latency? If we delay replays we'll miss SLA for aggregates.

ara: tradeoff configurable per-priority lane. For high priority (alerts) set cooldown=0, for normal metrics put 10m cooldown. See draft config:

```
replayer:
  slice_cooldown_seconds: 600
  allow_override_priorities: [alerting, realtime]
  dedupe_window_seconds: 120
```

mira: how do we surface this in console? Need dashboard showing cooling slices and pending requests. Otherwise customers will think their metrics are missing.

sam: Agreed. Console should show 'slice state' metric + heatmap. Also expose per-tenant cooldown overrides.

jon: Implementation notes: annotate slice logs with cool_id and emit metric replayer.slice.cooling true/false. Replayer can push a telemetry event slice.cooldown.start/stop.

backfill-bot: alert: replayer job 987654321 failed with OOM while backfilling slice 2026-07-11T01:00Z

ara: Thanks — that OOM is exactly the risk we're trying to reduce by cooldowns. Can we add a circuit-breaker for concurrent jobs per host too?

kevin: yes, limit concurrent slice jobs per host to 2 and global backfill concurrency to 20 for now. We can safe-scale later.

mira: UX: add toggle in rollout UX to enable cooldown and configure default seconds. Also add tooltip: 'prevents duplicate replays when upstream watermark oscillates'.

sam: Next steps: ara to open RFC PR for slice cooldown config + replayer changes; jon to add metrics; mira to wire console heatmap; kevin to update infra concurrency caps. Ping @eng-sre for review.

ara: I'll open PR by EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
